· MACD histogram trajectory (0.1544→1.7517) + Improving trend, signaling further strength.

[Support & Resistance Structure]

· Swing resistance ($334.99) + Breakout could lead to retest of 52-week high ($344.57).
· 5-day/20-day price action (Higher Low) + Confirms continuation of uptrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.85x) + Normal volume, supporting current price action.
· Current phase diagnosis (Uptrend) + Entry conditions met, expecting further upside.
